descriptors.description: Critical Failure: Core systems failing. Emergency power only, weapons offline, mobility severely limited. Immediate maintenance required.
Severe Damage: Multiple systems compromised. Mobility impaired, weapon systems unstable, armor integrity compromised.
Minor Damage: Surface dents and scratches present. Some systems running at reduced efficiency but core functions stable.
Operational: All systems functioning at optimal capacity. Combat-ready and fully armed.

stats.name: Health

stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Emergency Power: Severe power depletion, barely maintaining basic functions. Emergency shutdown imminent.
Low Power: Battery reserves critical, systems operating in power-saving mode. Performance notably diminished.
Draining: Power reserves at moderate levels, operating with slightly reduced efficiency but maintaining core functions.
Energized: Battery fully charged, systems running at peak efficiency. Ready for extended operations.

stats.name: Power

stats.description: Live readout of how well the drone can move — tracks Power, and craters when the core is badly damaged.

descriptors.description: Crippled: Barely able to move. Most terrain is impassable; risk of full immobilization.
Impaired: Significant mobility loss. Handling is sluggish and rough terrain is hazardous.
Steady: Some reduction in speed, but stable, controllable movement.
Agile: Wheels and gyros at full performance. Quick, precise, sure-footed.

stats.name: Mobility

stats.description: Live readout of weapon output — scales with Power, drops with core damage, and spikes when Charge hits Overdrive.

descriptors.description: Disabled: Weapon systems critically starved. Barely able to engage.
Weak: Major output loss. Shots are underpowered and slow to cycle.
Stable: Weapons functional at solid output. Reliable in a fight.
Peak: Cannon at full power — and if Charge is maxed, Overdrive is ready to fire.

stats.name: Firepower

stats.description: Overdrive meter. Fills as the drone lands hits and takes bold risks; at full it can unleash a single devastating Overdrive burst, then empties.

descriptors.description: Depleted: No reserve. The capacitors need to spin back up.
Building: Charge accumulating. Overdrive still a ways off.
High: Capacitors humming, nearly primed. Overdrive close.
OVERDRIVE READY: Capacitors maxed. One devastating burst available — firing it empties the meter.

traits.playerDescription: A devastating ranged breath attack — fire, venom, or energy to match your type. Each blast takes a lot out of you.

traits.aiDescription: The player regenerates: wounds visibly knit closed over minutes. The healing constantly draws on their energy.
traits.name: Regenerator
traits.playerDescription: Your wounds visibly knit closed. The healing burns energy you could have spent smashing.

traits.aiDescription: The player has vast wings: they can glide or fly short distances between districts, over cordons and armor entirely. Their frame is lighter and more fragile for it.

traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is berserk — fury feeding itself, attacks wild and relentless, ignoring pain and caution entirely. Their wounds go untended and worsen while it lasts.
traits.name: Berserk State
traits.playerDescription: Let the fury off its leash. Your Rampage feeds itself while this is on — but your wounds get worse, not better.

stats.description: How far the slime has spread through the player. Climbs steadily on its own, spikes on slime contact, and falls with remedies, rest, and salt-scrubbing.

descriptors.description: Early signs. A faint green tint under the fingernails; skin cool to the touch. Nothing anyone would notice in this fog.

Translucent. Skin faintly see-through at the wrists and temples; joints move too smoothly. The player can compress their hands and arms through gaps bones should forbid, and slimes pause before striking — half-reading them as kin.
Softening. The player’s outline blurs in the rain; grip fails on anything heavy; recent memories arrive syrupy and out of order. Slimes ignore them entirely now. People very much do not.
Assimilated. The player settles into the goo — calm, painless, and no longer the person who started tonight. The story ends here, quietly.

traits.aiDescription: The player stays deliberate under pressure — fear drains away quickly and rarely drives their choices.

traits.playerDescription: Slow breath, clean decisions.

descriptors.description: Empty. Hollow and rumbling — the curse loves this.

Overstuffed. Waddling at best — running is a fantasy, and the player mostly wants to lie down in the frosting.

descriptors.description: Clean-ish. A dusting of powdered sugar; unremarkable to the wildlife.
Dusted. Tacky fingers, sparkling hair; a passing swarmer's antennae twitch toward the player.
Sticky. Trailing caramel threads; sprinkle swarmers change course toward the player.
A walking dessert. Syrup-coated head to toe — every creature in sight considers the player food.

traitGroups.name: Build
traitGroups.playerDescription: What you're working with. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Pantry Tricks
traitGroups.playerDescription: Tricks for a world made of pudding. Take any.

traits.aiDescription: The player manages the curse by grazing — small bites, often. The hunger builds noticeably slower for them.
traits.name: Grazer
traits.playerDescription: Little and often. The curse stays drowsy if you keep it snacking.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat enormous amounts in one sitting before feeling it — but the curse burns hotter in them.
traits.name: Glutton
traits.playerDescription: Go big. You can pack it away like a champion — and the curse loves you for it.

traits.aiDescription: The player resists the curse better than anyone — the hunger builds slowly — but the constant refusal wears them down.
traits.name: Iron Will
traits.playerDescription: You've told it no before. It costs you.

traits.aiDescription: The player is quick and light on their feet, recovering breath fast between sprints.
traits.name: Nimble
traits.playerDescription: Quick over the crumb fields, quicker up a wafer tree.

traits.aiDescription: The player is solidly built — they shrug off rams, tumbles, and cyclone landings that would flatten others.
traits.name: Sturdy
traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.

traits.aiDescription: The player is unusually light: fast and far-jumping, tossed further by cyclones and rams but landing soft. Less mass to absorb a real hit.
traits.name: Featherlight
traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: Room for seconds. And thirds.

traits.aiDescription: Food genuinely satisfies the player — every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse hates that.

traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, with a hunger that comes back sooner.
traits.name: Sugar Rush
traits.playerDescription: Everything you eat hits like rocket fuel — and burns off just as fast.

traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is actively white-knuckling the curse — jaw set, fists closed, refusing every smell. The craving quiets while this holds, but the effort is visibly exhausting.
traits.name: Gritted Teeth
traits.playerDescription: White-knuckle the curse into silence. It works. It costs.

traits.aiDescription: The player is solidly built — they shrug off rams, tumbles, and cyclone landings that would flatten others.
traits.name: Sturdy
traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.

traits.aiDescription: The player is unusually light: fast and far-jumping, tossed further by cyclones and rams but landing soft. Less mass to absorb a real hit.
traits.name: Featherlight
traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.

traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.
traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: Room for seconds. And thirds.

traits.aiDescription: Food genuinely satisfies the player — every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.
traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse hates that.

traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, with a hunger that comes back sooner.
traits.name: Sugar Rush
traits.playerDescription: Everything you eat hits like rocket fuel — and burns off just as fast.

traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is actively white-knuckling the curse — jaw set, fists closed, refusing every smell. The craving quiets while this holds, but the effort is visibly exhausting.
traits.name: Gritted Teeth
traits.playerDescription: White-knuckle the curse into silence. It works. It costs.

traits.playerDescription: So beloved the swarm hesitates to lay hands on you — but it grows with every sighting.

traits.playerDescription: Respected, not just adored. You can bluff with rules, and the crowd organizes against you more slowly.

traits.playerDescription: Sugar burns off you fast. Eat, grimace, keep moving.

traits.playerDescription: You can pack away far more chocolate before crashing. The problem: you kind of want to.

traits.aiDescription: The player has a dainty appetite — even a few chocolates push them toward a sugar crash, so every accepted box matters.
traits.name: Dainty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: A few chocolates is already a lot. The crash comes early — dodge like it matters.

traits.aiDescription: The player is wearing proper running shoes — quick acceleration and fast stamina recovery.
traits.name: Running Shoes
traits.playerDescription: You wore the good ones today. Stamina comes back quicker.

traits.aiDescription: The player carries a box of store-bought decoy chocolates. Thrown or dropped, they scatter admirers who scramble for them; re-gifted, they can redirect an admirer’s attention entirely.
traits.name: Decoy Chocolates
traits.playerDescription: A box of store-bought chocolates to throw, drop, or re-gift as a distraction.

traits.name: Annotated School Map
traits.playerDescription: A hand-drawn map of every shortcut, fire door, and blind spot in the building.

traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is sprinting flat out — much harder to catch, ignoring pleasantries, vaulting obstacles. Sustained sprinting is exhausting.
traits.name: All-Out Sprint
traits.playerDescription: Drop everything and run flat out. Fast — but your stamina stops recovering while it’s on.
